html:
Jun started a new job at an animation studio in Toronto while Marisol baked conchas in Mexico City. Priya spent time at the hospital with her grandmother in Bengaluru as Ana worked at a hackathon in Vancouver.
The Long-Distance Weekly
Issue 12

Jun got a shot approved while Bea lost an umbrella

Jun started a new job at an animation studio in Toronto while Marisol baked conchas in Mexico City. Priya spent time at the hospital with her grandmother in Bengaluru as Ana worked at a hackathon in Vancouver.

Ana, Vancouver
Ana built a newspaper app at HackCamp
Ana spent her weekend at HackCamp at UBC, building a little newspaper for the group.
Bea, London
Bea bought a raincoat after losing an umbrella
Bea spent four days in the rain and watched her second umbrella invert and fly into the Thames on Waterloo Bridge.
Jun, Toronto
Jun got his first animation shot approved
Jun started at an animation studio, securing a desk next to the window after spending four hours learning how the render farm works.
Marisol, Mexico City
Marisol perfected her abuela's concha recipe
Marisol tried baking her abuela's concha recipe, but her first attempt came out flat, "like pancakes with a sugar hat." After learning from her mom that the dough had…
Priya, Bengaluru
Priya cared for her grandmother in Bengaluru
Priya took turns staying at the hospital after her grandmother was admitted on Monday night with breathing problems.
Little victories
  • Jun's first shot approved. Jun redid a three-second walk cycle four times before his lead approved the shot.
  • Marisol baked perfect conchas. Marisol's second batch of conchas came out perfect and vanished quickly at her lab.
  • Ana got login working late. Ana and her team got login working at two in the morning during HackCamp.
Looking ahead
  • Bea landing home on December 18. Bea booked her flight home, landing on December 18.
  • Jun pitching short film idea. Jun will pitch a short film about a lighthouse keeper who collects lost umbrellas next Friday.
  • Marisol's thesis committee meeting. Marisol has a thesis committee meeting on Wednesday to discuss chapter three.
  • Priya asking for weekend calls. Priya requested a call on Sunday morning her time.
